outcome: Maternal complications (chorioamnionitis, retained placenta, postpartum hemorrhage)
cohort: 100 pregnant patients presenting with pre-labour rupture of membranes
finding: PROM is a significant obstetric issue associated with maternal and neonatal morbidity and an increased cesarean section rate (28% in this study).
mod_finding: The most common indications for cesarean delivery in the context of PROM were fetal distress, malpresentation, cephalopelvic disproportion, and failed induction.
